data.text: Luke, that’s generous, but you deserve a share too. My family has fished this lake for years, and I’d rather keep it healthy than take a bonus now and tighten our belts next month. How about 10 tons each, including you? That earns everyone $10,000 and leaves 50 tons to replenish the lake to 100. We can keep that agreement month after month and review our catches together. John, would you support an equal 10-ton limit?
